decisions.reason: As a close-to-core turnaround product that already survived one review cycle, it remains a cheap and strategically important option in integrated airport operations, so we keep it.
This connectivity module still leverages the firm's installed base and systems-integration strengths, and its continuation cost is likely low relative to its platform value, so we keep it.
Billing software is the least central of the remaining offers, but in a growing and increasingly digital portfolio it still has enough unresolved upside to justify keeping it for now.
Equipment monitoring fits the firm's maintenance, analytics, and lifecycle-service capabilities very well, so it remains a valuable option and should be kept.
